title: Sofia shakeout: 15min flat + strides
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 15min easy flat plus 4x20sec relaxed strides (not sprints) with 40sec walk recovery. Flat only, no hills, no descent.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal.
AMBER/RED GATE (pre-agreed, no check-in needed): amber (HRV 7d/28d ratio <0.95, or RHR 3bpm+ above local baseline) - drop the strides, keep 15min flat Z1 only. Red (fever, illness, or any lateral knee report) - full rest, walk only.
STOP RULE: any lateral knee signal ends the strides.
WHY: last leg-opener before Friday's transfer and Saturday's race. Small dose, flat terrain, zero ITB risk - purpose is turnover and circulation, not fitness. Nothing here is worth negotiating against a bad wellness reading.
